operators.name: get_arg
operators.description: The indexed source argument, receiver first; structured source values and pointer metadata are preserved.

operators.name: get_result
operators.description: The source result. All values also carry invocation metadata via field call, even a unit result. A trait-item contract has an abstract call context whose invocations range over all relevant implementations/member calls; it does not invent a result for an unnamed method.

operators.name: get_field
operators.description: 统一投影真实源字段、建模属性或容器成员；具体来源和同名消歧由解析器结合源声明及类型绑定识别。
overloads: Value x resolved Rust source field selector -> source Value
Record x StringLiteral -> declared field type

operators.name: get_allocation
operators.description: Returns the allocation/provenance object associated with a pointer-like value.

operators.name: memory_range
operators.description: Constructs a half-open byte range [ptr.address, ptr.address + size).

operators.name: memory_between
operators.description: Constructs the half-open byte range between two addresses, independent of their order.

operators.name: offset_does_not_wrap
operators.description: Uses mathematical 128-bit arithmetic to check that ptr plus a signed offset, an unsigned add offset, or an unsigned sub offset does not cross the address-space boundary. direction is signed, add, or sub.

operators.name: mul_fits
operators.description: Uses 128-bit mathematical multiplication and checks that the result fits the target integer type. target is one of isize, usize, i32, u32, i64, or u64; pointer-sized targets use KLEE's current pointer width. Plain operands are non-negative mathematical integers; wrap a signed operand with as_signed.

operators.name: as_signed
operators.description: Interprets a bit-vector value as isize, i32, or i64 and sign-extends it for mathematical arithmetic.

operators.name: get_type_at_func
operators.description: Returns metadata for the indexed type parameter of the target callee.

operators.name: is_power_of_two
operators.description: Returns whether x is a non-zero power of two.

operators.name: is_valid_for
operators.description: Reusable range predicate. The access argument selects precisely one property; it does not imply the other properties. read/write/read_write: the entire half-open range lies in one currently live allocation with that access permission (write requires writable storage); zero-byte ranges are vacuously valid. These modes impose no alignment or initialization. initialized: the range contains initialized Rust values of the optional type_info (otherwise the range element type); each value obeys Rust language validity, including discriminants, references and niches, without requiring padding bytes to be written. bit_valid: the stored bits satisfy only Rust language type validity. invariants: the type-defined safety invariants, beyond language-level bit validity, hold for the values; type_info identifies the type contract. drop/async_drop: precisely the type-defined precondition for the respective destructor, including additional type invariants. utf8/wtf8: the bytes in exactly the range encode that format, without adding allocation/alignment requirements. shared_borrow/read_no_mutation: no conflicting write occurs throughout the returned reference lifetime, except inside UnsafeCell. unique_borrow: accesses during that lifetime must be derived from the returned unique reference. volatile_read_no_race: no unordered overlapping write; volatile_write_no_race: no unordered overlapping other access. exclusive_during_drop: while the destructor runs, all overlapping accesses derive from its supplied self references. no_use_after_drop: no access to the dropped value after destruction. Each temporal mode refers to the current invocation/result lifetime; it is not a call-time capability approximation. Unknown access strings are not defined and must not be invented.

operators.name: c_str_in_allocation
operators.description: Returns whether a non-null pointer has a reachable nul byte before the first uninitialized byte and before the end of the same live KLEE allocation. Symbolic pointers are resolved as a disjunction over live objects.

operators.name: has_nul_terminator
operators.description: Returns whether ptr has a reachable initialized nul terminator in a live KLEE allocation, including for symbolic pointer values.

operators.name: is_convertible_to_ref
operators.description: Atomic predicate for Rust raw-pointer-to-reference convertibility.

operators.name: is_initialized_for_type
operators.description: 等价于 is_valid_for(range,"initialized",T)：按 T 的 Rust 初始化及语言有效性检查，允许 padding 未写入。

examples.rule: `layout` must have non-zero size.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(1), "size") > 0

examples.rule: The `ptr` pointer must be a block of memory currently allocated via this allocator.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation") != None && get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "live") && get_field(get_arg(1), "address") == get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "start") && get_field(get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "allocator"), "id") == get_field(get_arg(0), "id")

examples.rule: `layout` must fit that block of memory.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation") != None && get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "live") && get_field(get_arg(2), "align") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "layout"), "align") && get_field(get_arg(2), "size") >= get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "minimum_size") && get_field(get_arg(2), "size") <= get_field(get_field(get_arg(1), "allocation"), "size")

examples.rule: `new_layout.size()` must be greater than or equal to `old_layout.size()`.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(3), "size") >= get_field(get_arg(2), "size")

examples.rule: Every byte in the array must be in `0..=127`.
examples.expression: forall byte in get_field(get_field(get_arg(0), "pointee"), "elements"): byte >= 0 && byte <= 127

examples.rule: The source and destination may not overlap.
examples.expression: (get_field(get_arg(0), "address") + get_arg(2) * get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "size") <= get_field(get_arg(1), "address")) || (get_field(get_arg(1), "address") + get_arg(2) * get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "size") <= get_field(get_arg(0), "address"))

examples.rule: If the unsized tail of `T` is a slice, the size of the entire value (dynamic tail length + statically sized prefix) must fit in `isize`.
examples.expression: (get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "tail_type") != None && get_field(get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "tail_type"), "kind") == "slice") => (get_field(get_arg(0), "length") == 0 || mul_fits(get_field(get_arg(0), "dynamic_size"), 1, "isize"))
examples.note: 保留源文档的 slice-tail 长度为零例外。

examples.rule: If the unsized tail of `T` is a trait object, the vtable part of the pointer must point to a valid vtable for the type `T` acquired by an unsizing coercion.
examples.expression: (get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "tail_type") != None && get_field(get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "tail_type"), "kind") == "trait_object") => (get_field(get_arg(0), "vtable") != None && get_field(get_field(get_arg(0), "vtable"), "origin") == "unsizing" && get_field(get_field(get_field(get_arg(0), "vtable"), "target"), "id") == get_field(get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "tail_type"), "id"))
examples.note: 检查有类型的 vtable 目标和来源路径；完整翻译还要约束元数据初始化及 vtable 存储有效性。

examples.rule: Neither Self nor Rhs have provenance, so integer comparisons are correct.
examples.expression: !get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "has_provenance") && !get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Rhs"), "has_provenance")

examples.rule: Self and Rhs have no padding.
examples.expression: !get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "has_padding") && !get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Rhs"), "has_padding")

examples.rule: `digit` must return an ASCII character.
examples.expression: forall inv in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "contract"), "invocations"): (get_field(inv, "method") != None && get_field(get_field(inv, "method"), "name") == "digit" && get_field(get_field(inv, "method"), "defining_trait") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "contract"), "trait"), "id") && get_field(inv, "status") == "return") => (get_field(inv, "result") >= 0 && get_field(inv, "result") <= 127)

examples.rule: The iterator source `S` itself must implement `SourceIter<Source = S>`.
examples.expression: (get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "SourceIter"), "id") in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "trait_impls"), get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "SourceIter"), "id")), "associated_types"), "Source"), "traits")) && get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "trait_impls"), get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "SourceIter"), "id")), "associated_types"), "Source"), "trait_impls"), get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "SourceIter"), "id")), "associated_types"), "Source"), "id") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "trait_impls"), get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "SourceIter"), "id")), "associated_types"), "Source"), "id")

examples.rule: All public StepBy methods must be specialized.
examples.expression: forall key in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "methods"): get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "methods"), key), "visibility") == "public" => (forall target in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "methods"), key), "dispatch_targets"): get_field(target, "defining_trait") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "StepByImpl"), "id") => get_field(target, "specialized"))
examples.note: 展示 public 方法到已解析 spec dispatch 项的路径；完整公式需结合 setup/特化分支条件，不把 wrapper 自身必须有特化体当作规则。

examples.rule: All subtypes and all supertypes of `Self` must also implement `TrustedRandomAccess`.
examples.expression: (forall subtype in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "subtypes"): get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "TrustedRandomAccess"), "id") in get_field(subtype, "traits")) && (forall supertype in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "supertypes"): get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "traits"), "TrustedRandomAccess"), "id") in get_field(supertype, "traits"))

examples.rule: It is immediate undefined behavior to call this function on nearly all types, including integer types and arrays of integer types, even if the result is unused.
examples.expression: get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "allows_uninitialized")

examples.rule: The value must be representable in the return type `Int`, after truncating off its fractional part.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(0), "truncated") != None && get_field(get_arg(0), "truncated") >= get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "min") && get_field(get_arg(0), "truncated") <= get_field(get_type_at_func(0), "max")

examples.rule: The resource pointed to by `fd` must be open and suitable for assuming ownership.
examples.expression: get_field(get_arg(0), "resource") != None && get_field(get_field(get_arg(0), "resource"), "open") && get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "caller") in get_field(get_field(get_arg(0), "resource"), "owners")
examples.note: cleanup 操作要求属于 rule-714，不混入此公式；owners 是处置权主体令牌，不要求 Rust owner 包装器存在或额外要求唯一性。

examples.rule: Any bit pattern must be valid for the type.
examples.expression: forall bits in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "bit_patterns"): bits in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "types"), "Self"), "valid_bit_patterns")

examples.rule: All writes to untrusted memory must be either preceded by the VERW instruction and followed by the MFENCE; LFENCE instruction sequence or be in multiples of 8 bytes aligned to an 8-byte boundary.
examples.expression: forall write in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "events"): (get_field(write, "kind") == "write" && get_field(write, "range") != None && get_field(get_field(write, "range"), "region") == "user" && (get_field(write, "invocation") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "invocation"), "identity") || get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "invocation"), "identity") in get_field(write, "causal_ancestors"))) => ((get_field(get_field(get_field(write, "range"), "pointer"), "address") % 8 == 0 && get_field(get_field(write, "range"), "size") % 8 == 0) || (exists before in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "events"): get_field(before, "strand") == get_field(write, "strand") && get_field(before, "thread") == get_field(write, "thread") && get_field(before, "instruction") == "VERW" && get_field(before, "instruction_index") + 1 == get_field(write, "instruction_index") && (exists fence in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "events"): get_field(fence, "strand") == get_field(write, "strand") && get_field(fence, "thread") == get_field(write, "thread") && get_field(fence, "instruction") == "MFENCE" && get_field(fence, "instruction_index") == get_field(write, "instruction_index") + 1 && (exists after in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "events"): get_field(after, "strand") == get_field(write, "strand") && get_field(after, "thread") == get_field(write, "thread") && get_field(after, "instruction") == "LFENCE" && get_field(after, "instruction_index") == get_field(write, "instruction_index") + 2))))
examples.note: 屏障/对齐组合候选式；需要将实际平台 instruction_index/strand 观测与 Intel 契约核对，不声明已完成平台语义验证。

examples.rule: This function must be called only once during runtime initialization.
examples.expression: get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "state"), "phase") == "runtime_initialization" && (forall key in get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "invocations"): (get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "invocations"), key), "qualified_name") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "invocation"), "qualified_name") && get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "invocations"), key), "before"), "phase") == "runtime_initialization") => get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "trace"), "invocations"), key), "identity") == get_field(get_field(get_field(get_result(), "call"), "invocation"), "identity"))
examples.note: 在当前调用进入状态上检查历史，trace 中未发生的未来调用不参与本次调用前置条件。
